ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white region covering the central and interior fluke area; low-intensity black pigmentation is restricted to a narrow perimeter along the trailing edge and heavy concentrations at the distal tips; scattered low-intensity focal pixels (spots) are visible in the mid-right and mid-left regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies significantly, with the most prominent jagged variations occurring on the right lobe (viewer perspective).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transition, sweeping upward towards the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a smooth concave trajectory meeting at the central peduncle area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast textured clusters of roughly circular/spherical pixel masses (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at both the extreme left and extreme right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned gray linear disruptions visible on the right lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white field toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization/bio-fouling clusters on both distal tips; scattered dark focal spots (pigmentation or minor scarring) across the central-right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-white pigmentation profile (Type 1 classification) with minimal black encroachment from the trailing edge boundary.
